rulings: Architect A3/A4 and D3 (issue #215 comment 6537418060): host-dependent predicates are explicit, separately identified subcases executed on the ratified 2751 bounded test profile; they may not make the deterministic mutation verdict ambiguous.
separation_rule: The deterministic verdict (nc4_03_mutation_set.v1.json, _nc4_03_mutations.run_deterministic) is computed first, from pinned source only, and recorded with its own sha256. These subcases are computed afterwards by _nc4_03_host.run_host_subcases, are reported under their own row ids and statuses, and are never inputs to the deterministic verdict. BLOCKED means the ratified profile is unavailable or the probe could not observe: it is reported as BLOCKED (acceptance INCOMPLETE for that row) and never converted to PASS or FAIL, and never changes NC4-03.

status_semantics.PASS: every named fact held on the ratified profile
status_semantics.FAIL: an observed fact contradicts the ratified profile
status_semantics.BLOCKED: profile unavailable (Yama absent, identities not named, not root, developer-optout, probe error); no weaker substitute
